palette: deep navy blue, slate blue-grey, warm off-white cream, electric blue accent, coral red accent, a touch of gold for money.

shots.prompt: A young man with short brown hair and a light beard, wearing a blue hoodie, stands with open arms on top of a giant mountain of plain green banknotes at night; behind him a huge glowing full moon; a tiny crowd at the foot of the money mountain looks up at him.
Close-up of two hands from the bottom of the frame throwing a fan of plain green banknotes into the air; banknotes fly and spin across the whole frame with soft shadows on a warm cream background.

A tiny round planet floating in a starry navy sky; on top of it a small green island country with a little castle; a young man in a blue hoodie plants a coral red flag with a white star on the highest hill.

A small cozy teenager's bedroom at night: an eighteen-year-old boy with short brown hair and no beard, wearing a blue hoodie, sits at a desk talking to a small camera on a tripod, desk lamp glow, a window with a dark blue night sky, an analog wall clock, blank posters with abstract shapes.

The same teenager's bedroom in early morning light: the same boy in the blue hoodie slumped over the desk, exhausted but still talking to the camera on the tripod, dozens of empty snack wrappers and cans around, sunrise in the window, the wall clock.
An enormous stadium seen from high above at dusk, filled with thousands of tiny people holding up glowing phones, rows of seats curving away into the distance.
A small private tropical island seen from above: white sand, palm trees, a little villa with a pool, turquoise water with coral, a tiny motor boat arriving with a white wake.
Wide rolling green hills covered with long neat rows of freshly planted young trees, small volunteers with shovels in the distance, soft blue sky with a few clouds, fresh morning light.
A sunny village in a dry savanna: smiling children fill colorful plastic containers with clean water at a new hand pump well, acacia trees, warm afternoon light, long soft shadows.
A giant TV studio arena: a thousand contestants in identical teal outfits stand in neat rows on a huge glowing floor, spotlights cross from above, a giant round vault door glows in the background.
A vintage cash register on a shop counter, its drawer sliding open, gold coins jumping out in arcs, musical notes floating up into the air above it, a soft spotlight from above.
A giant glossy red rounded button on a pedestal in the middle of an empty night plaza, one tiny person reaching up to press it, a dramatic spotlight from above, a long shadow.
View from behind a person sitting on a couch in a dark living room at night, holding a phone whose screen glows red and lights up the room; a small blue passport lies on the coffee table.
